title: 1권 3유닛 스토리북 · 2쪽
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. One single continuous picture: never split it into panels, frames or a collage, and draw each character only once. No humans or human children anywhere in the picture; every creature is an animal (Fairy E is the only fairy). Full-page picture-book illustration. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: Hedgie holds out a red gift box with a yellow ribbon toward the goat; the goat's eyes go wide and a LARGE glowing golden seed (as big as a plum) shoots out of its mouth into the air with a burst of sparkles — the seed is the brightest thing in the picture. Pip tries to say a sound but only hiccups. Pip is HICCUPPING, clearly not happy or smiling: Pip's body jerks up off the ground in a sudden jolt, its eyes are wide open in surprise, its cheeks are puffed out, one wing is pressed over its beak, there are short zig-zag jolt lines around its body and three small round bubbles popping up from its beak. A hen pecks by the fence; a chubby hippo lies in a muddy puddle nearby with a second small seed on its head. Hidden in the picture: the gift, the hen, the hippo, a hammer in a toolbox. Grumble peeks from behind a bush: one acorn earmuff has fallen off and his lantern shows a small flame. Also clearly visible in the picture (each character only once): Bun the white rabbit in green boots, talking and pointing. The goat stands on four legs like a real goat. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small round hedgehog with BRIGHT ORANGE spikes (never brown), a peach-colored face and cream belly, standing on two legs, one tiny blue flower stuck in the spikes, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
